summary: Diagnosed flaky test defect in Test 5 where a hardcoded static eventId collided with persistent records from previous test runs, causing Execution 1 to trigger P2002 deduplication instead of inserting successfully.
evidence: Symptom reproduced: npm test failed on run 2 with 'Expected status success on initial job execution, got deduplicated'
Root cause isolated: hardcoded eventId clk_replay_static_shared_event persisted in ClickEvent across test runs
Remediation prescribed: mint unique eventId per run with crypto.randomUUID() and enforce clean test teardown
